page.notes: Left margin note "f Zonaras." is printed in small type beside the first line; it is placed as a foot note keyed to the mark "f" in the text, not in a margin tag, because the mark in the text is the same letter. The symbol after "Postremò," and the word after "sub" are doubtful. The Greek word ἀναλφάβητος is copied as best read. The right printed page is cut off at the scan edge: only line ends such as "gat", "cju", "fcr", "nih", "gra", "mi", "qui", "Th", "n°", "Ro", "om", "qu", "net", "rer", "Ee", "ξo", "cis", "tar", "et", "de", "toa", "ne", "et", "ler", "in", "tic", "et" and a header letter "L" are visible. These fragments are not transcribed as text, since they are too cut off to read reliably and do not form words.
